items.title: Ukraine reportedly orders verification of military registration records
items.summary: Ukraine's cabinet has reportedly instructed authorities to verify military registration information for men aged 17 to 60. The Defence Ministry is expected to receive information from government registers, including identity, residence and citizenship records.

items.title: Lavrov argues West must negotiate rather than dictate sanctions policy
items.summary: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov argued that Western countries would remain important international actors but would increasingly have to negotiate with other countries rather than dictate their foreign relationships and sanctions policies.

items.title: EU reportedly faces €100 billion in Ukraine loan expenditure
items.summary: A report citing an unnamed source puts anticipated EU expenditure on loans for Kyiv over the next seven years at €100 billion. The available report does not establish that a final funding agreement has been reached.

items.title: Russia claims strike on Ukrainian drone facility
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said its forces destroyed a Ukrainian drone control and storage facility in the Dnipropetrovsk direction. The claimed result has not been independently verified.
